claim_text: #### Strand 3: Tensor-based Knowledge Representation The core knowledge representation appears to be "tensors" - structured documents that capture observations and insights: - `src/yanantin/apacheta/models/tensor.py` - Defines tensor data structures - `src/yanantin/apacheta/operators/` - Contains operators for manipulating tensors (compose, correct, dissent, evolve, etc.) - `docs/tensors.md` - Documentation on tensor concept These tensors seem to be the fundamental unit of knowledge in the system, allowing for composition, correction, and evolution of AI observations over time.
